quests.title: Fill an empty cell
quests.ask: Write `level_pile()`: on an empty cell, it leaves a pile of exactly 2 gems.
quests.nudge: One gem is not enough. How does the robot know when to stop adding?

quests.title: Shrink a big pile
quests.ask: Called on a cell with a big pile, `level_pile()` should leave exactly 2 gems there too.
quests.nudge: Too few and too many are two different problems. Does your function handle both?

quests.title: Level a whole corridor
quests.ask: Now a short corridor that starts on a big pile. Every cell, the first one too, should end with exactly 2 gems.
quests.nudge: Does the robot ever look at the cell it starts on?
